items.text: Indiana has no medical or adult-use cannabis. Possessing marijuana, hash oil or hashish is a Class B misdemeanour (Indiana Code 35-48-4-11), rising to a more serious offence for larger amounts with a prior drug conviction. Cannabis bought legally in a neighbouring state is still covered once in Indiana.
Alcohol may be served from 7 am to 3 am every day. Carry-out sales (from shops) on Sunday are allowed only from noon to 8 pm (Indiana Code 7.1-3-1-14).

laws.rule: Indiana drivers may not hold or use a phone or other telecommunications device while the vehicle is moving (Indiana Code 9-21-8-59, from 1 July 2020), and state guidance says holding a phone is banned even at red lights. Hands-free or voice-operated use, including hands-free GPS, is allowed, and a phone may be held to call 911 in an emergency.
